business_profile.tagline: Austin Eastside Neighborhood Bakery, Café, Bar, and Beer Garden
business_profile.description: Sour Duck Market is a neighborhood bakery, cafe, bar, and beer garden in East Austin offering handcrafted fresh baked goods, sandwiches, and snacks made from locally sourced ingredients, sustainable coffee, craft cocktails, and a wide selection of beer and wine.
business_profile.value_proposition: Scratch-made local food and drinks inspired by Texas farmers and purveyors, served in a relaxed, family-friendly and dog-friendly neighborhood environment.
business_profile.target_audience: Austin locals, families, remote workers, neighborhood residents, and food enthusiasts looking for local scratch-made bakery items, craft drinks, and casual outdoor dining.
key_differentiators: Meats smoked daily in a 1,000-gallon pit smoker
Flour for baked goods milled locally from Barton Springs Mill
Expansive yard and beer garden space with first-come, first-served seating
Extensive wholesale partnerships across Austin's finest coffee shops and markets

services_and_products.name: Breakfast Tacos & Sandwiches
services_and_products.description: Morning favorites featuring local ingredients, eggs, and house-made breakfast sausage.
features: Breakfast taco with queso fresco and red chili salsa
Breakfast sammy with sausage patty and aji verde

services_and_products.name: Smoked Meats & Sandwiches
services_and_products.description: House-smoked meats prepared in a 1,000-gallon pit smoker paired with fresh local bread.

services_and_products.name: Artisan Bakery & Pastries
services_and_products.description: Naturally leavened hearth bread, enriched buns, flaky croissants, and cookies made with locally milled flour.

services_and_products.name: Bar & Happy Hour
services_and_products.description: Craft cocktails, sustainable coffee, and a killer selection of beer, wine, and non-alcoholic beverages.
features: Signature cocktails, local craft beers, and ciders

brand_and_content.brand_positioning: Austin's premier neighborhood bakery, cafe, and beer garden celebrating local purveyors and scratch-made Texas comfort food.
hero_headlines: Austin Eastside Neighborhood Bakery, Café, Bar, and Beer Garden
important_copy_snippets: We believe in showing true craftsmanship in cooking by serving good, local food, made the way nature intended—from scratch.

design_and_ux.visual_aesthetic: Warm editorial, rustic neighborhood cafe style with vibrant food photography and clean typography.
design_and_ux.typography_assessment: Clear font hierarchy utilizing strong sans-serif headers paired with highly legible body copy suited for menus.
design_and_ux.color_palette_assessment: Earthy, warm tones reflecting a natural Texas aesthetic complemented by crisp white backgrounds and appetizing food imagery.
design_and_ux.layout_and_spacing: Modular menu layouts with generous spacing, prominent photography carousels, and easily accessible operational details.
design_and_ux.ux_navigation_flow: Straightforward navigation structure with clear access to daily menus, brunch, happy hour, FAQs, and online ordering integration via Toast.
strengths: Extremely clear menus and pricing visibility
Comprehensive FAQ section addressing customer friction points (parking, dogs, kids, tabs)
weaknesses: Some long scrolling text pages could benefit from more interactive tabbed or accordion components
Social media links are primarily embedded as partner lists rather than direct brand channels on the footer

technical_and_seo.seo_health: Good foundational SEO with structured JSON-LD schemas and clear localized keywords for East Austin dining and bakery offerings.
seo_strengths: Clear keyword usage for neighborhood dining, bakery, and wholesale partners
seo_weaknesses: Meta descriptions could be more descriptive and tailored per subpage
technical_and_seo.accessibility_observations: Semantic heading structures are present, though image alt text coverage across marketing slider images could be enhanced.
technical_and_seo.performance_and_structure_notes: Well-structured static pages with reliable third-party ordering embeds.

redesign_recommendations.overall_redesign_verdict: The current website is functional and informative, but a modern frontend rebuild could significantly elevate the brand's rustic-chic aesthetic and streamline mobile ordering flows.
strategic_recommendations: Implement a modern headless or Jamstack architecture for lightning-fast menu loading
Highlight visual storytelling with an immersive gallery grid of bakery items and yard atmosphere
Streamline mobile navigation to prioritize instant takeout ordering and daily specials
ui_ux_improvements: Add interactive category filters for dietary needs (gluten-free, vegan, vegetarian) on the menu pages
Introduce sticky quick-action bars on mobile devices for hours, location, and ordering
rebuild_opportunities: Migrate to Next.js and Tailwind CSS for superior performance and bespoke brand styling
Integrate automated event booking forms directly into the site experience
quick_wins: Add direct social media icon links to the site header/footer
Optimize menu typography contrast for outdoor smartphone viewing

template_recommendation.reasoning: A warm editorial aesthetic with a single-page anchor flow or intuitive multi-section layout perfectly captures the community-driven, casual hospitality of a neighborhood cafe and beer garden.
